name: ENG1 or 2 FAIL
description: One engine has failed. Jerk in yaw axis (nose left), possible ROTOR RPM warning, red OEI flag on FLI, VMS indicates power loss of the affected engine.

procedure.text: Possibly: Warning Unit ROTOR RPM light and warning tone (if NR low). Master List shows GEN1 DISCONNECTED or GEN2 DISCONNECTED for the affected engine. FLI shows a red OEI flag.
Perform the single engine failure procedure matching the current flight phase (see branches below).

procedure.heading: HIGE (hover in ground effect):
procedure.text:
1. Landing attitude — Establish
2. Collective lever — Raise to cushion landing (note: below 95% rotor RPM, torque could increase from 128% up to 133%)
After landing:
3. Double engine emergency shutdown — Perform

procedure.heading: HOGE (hover out of ground effect):
procedure.text:
1. Collective lever — Adjust to maintain NR in normal range
Forced landing:
2. Landing attitude — Establish, raise collective to cushion landing, then perform double engine emergency shutdown
Transition to OEI flight (if height/airspeed permit):
2. Airspeed — Accelerate to Vy
3. Collective lever — Reduce power to OEI 2 min limit (at the latest when red OEI counter flashes), then to OEI MCP or below (amber counter flashes)
4. Affected engine — Identify
5. Single engine emergency shutdown — Perform
6. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE

procedure.heading: Takeoff:
procedure.text:
1. Collective lever — Adjust to maintain NR in normal range
Rejected takeoff:
2. Landing attitude — Establish, raise collective to cushion landing, then perform double engine emergency shutdown
Transition to OEI flight:
2. Airspeed — Accelerate to Vy
3. Collective lever — Reduce power to OEI 2 min limit, then OEI MCP or below
4. Affected engine — Identify
5. Single engine emergency shutdown — Perform
6. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE

procedure.heading: In flight:
procedure.text:
1. OEI flight condition — Establish
2. Affected engine — Identify
3. Single engine emergency shutdown — Perform
4. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE
Above 40 KIAS in AFCS 4-axis mode, NR stabilization is supported by AFCS collective inputs, depending on selected topping (OEI 30 sec/2 min).

references: FLM EC135 T3H Sect. 3.8.1 / 3.8.1.1-3.8.1.4 (Helionix Step 3.5, 3 MFD)
